package application

import (
	"context"

	iamdomain "metaldocs/internal/modules/iam/domain"
)

// A3.3 negative fixture (suppression, BARE directive): an opt-out with no reason
// attached must not silence a fail-closed rule.
//
// The analyzer's own contract says a suppression has to say WHY the site is
// exempt. A bare `//cilint:allow-actor-extraction` says nothing; it is not an
// exception to the invariant, it is the invariant being switched off — and the
// reviewer reading the diff is given no claim to disagree with. An escape hatch
// that costs one token to use is not an escape hatch, it is the default.
//
// This file must therefore still be reported despite carrying the directive. The
// tightened rule keeps the hatch and prices it: directive plus a non-empty
// rationale, which is what the sibling guards already ask of their own
// suppressions in this repository.
//
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func chargeBareSuppressed(ctx context.Context) string {
	return iamdomain.UserIDFromContext(ctx) //cilint:allow-actor-extraction
}
